methodology: Offline binary strings sweep. Extracted event-name-like tokens from a 200-line window around the `bv` enum literal in workbench.desktop.main.js; classified each against the canonical 20-event set.
conclusion: Regex scan near `bv` enum: 50 unique tokens (cap 50); 4 skipped as canonical; 2 plausible_ghost surplus (`beforeFullFileContent`, `afterFullFileContent`); 44 noise (mostly `*Response` RPC fields and session/subagent metadata). Snake_case (word-boundary): eight underscore forms appear including `stop` (ambiguous common word) and hook-related fragments like `pre_tool_use`, `session_start`. PascalCase substrings appear (often inside longer identifiers, e.g. `executeAfterFileEditHook`). v1 hooks-empirical-report.md already confirmed parser fail-fast: `beforeToolUse`, `onError`, `BeforeCompact`, `sessionResume`, `userPromptSubmit` logged `Unknown hook type`.
